verdict.rationale: The quickstart shows a single CLI command (`turso db create my-db`) creating a cloud database that you can connect to right away with `turso db shell`. The Platform API documents programmatic creation, token-scoping and teardown of per-user or per-agent databases, and the vendor says you can spin up thousands or millions of databases self-serve, which implies no capacity planning. Missing for 10: an explicit provisioning-time figure backing 'in seconds', an explicit statement that no instance sizing or capacity planning is needed, and independent hands-on corroboration of creation speed.
